name: Asako Yukitsuna
concept: Yukitsuna stops mid-stride on steep ground, breathing audibly while the rest keep pace, and does not ask them to wait.

answers.giri: Asako Yukitsuna serves Asako Satoru of the Inquisitors, and must report what she finds where the Taint has been at work even when it implicates someone she travelled with to find it.
answers.ninjo: Yukitsuna wants to believe the people she travels with are good, and stops asking hard questions when they give her reason to.
answers.standout_quality: Yukitsuna reads the currents in a room the way others read a text, and will pivot mid-sentence if she notices the mood shift beneath someone's words.
answers.accomplishment: She convinced a merchant caravan fleeing the Shadowlands approach to shelter a Hiruma widow and her children at Shiro Kaiu, though three families in the caravan had already refused them.
answers.challenge: On the Inquisitors' winter circuit through the Dragon foothills Yukitsuna fell behind on the steep passages, breathing hard while the others moved steadily on, and she did not ask them to slow down; the report of that circuit is the only one she has ever filed late.
answers.peace: Yukitsuna spreads a case's papers across the archive floor and traces the order of events in charcoal, checking each witness against the Asako records, and finds the moment when someone chose to stop telling the truth.
answers.fear: She stops asking the moment a suspect offers an explanation, then spends the ride home certain she has missed something and too impatient to turn back and verify it.
answers.accoutrement: Charcoal stub. Kept in the breast fold.

clan_relationship.text: Yukitsuna files her reports to Asako Satoru with the same precision she'd use on a theological manuscript, which makes it easier not to mention the parts where she decided the people beside her were trustworthy and stopped looking.

mentor.name: Moshi Yasunari
mentor.text: Moshi Yasunari taught her to read omens in shell and bone, but Yukitsuna still cannot ask a direct question of the spirits without feeling she is forcing an answer that was never meant for her.

answers.first_impression: Yukitsuna stops mid-stride on steep ground, breathing audibly while the rest keep pace, and does not ask them to wait.
answers.stress_reaction: Yukitsuna stops filing her reports and starts cross-referencing them instead, pulling apart what she wrote to find the contradiction she is certain is there, and becomes unreachable until she locates it or admits she was wrong.
answers.relationships:
Hiroaki (Fortunist Monk Order) — Hiroaki listens without interruption when Yukitsuna files her reports, then asks her to walk through the parts she crossed out, which means she has to say aloud the moments she decided to stop looking.
Mirumoto Gina (Dragon) — Mirumoto Gina taught Yukitsuna to move through difficult terrain without stopping, which made the mountain circuits shorter and made it impossible to admit she was struggling.
Isawa Machiko (Phoenix) — Isawa Machiko trained beside Yukitsuna under the Inquisitors and spent a season observing the Scorpion's Deathdealers three years ago. She came back with a report that names no one and a habit of asking Yukitsuna whether a man who kills the Tainted before they can speak is doing the Inquisitors' work or his own.

parent_opinion.description: Her father says she learned to read before she learned to stop, and now she arrives at conclusions the way a stone arrives at the bottom of a well—fast, and without checking if the water is still there to catch it.

answers.death: Yukitsuna will die at her desk in the Phoenix archives, mid-sentence in a report, because she finally found the contradiction she was looking for and did not survive the moment of understanding that she had decided not to see it the first time.
